items.title: FrontierML: a challenging, end-to-end machine learning benchmark (FrontierML)
items.summary: AI systems are not only going to be able to build themselves, but they can creatively sub-contract: When trying to solve complex problems, people don’t work alone. In fact, they often try to farm out bits of work to specialists around them to help make themselves more effective.

items.section: Import AI 481: AI sub-contractors; a wet lab for AI; and subterfuge during development
items.title: RSI Control: Can AI Models Perform Covert Sabotage in the Self-Improvement Process? (arXiv)
items.summary: we need to invest more in oversight of increasingly autonomous systems : Papers like this tell us that as we make more powerful AI systems we are going to need to invest more money into overseeing their work, especially given their ability to smuggle in tasks that may go against our own preferences.

items.title: LEMMO: A Large Electromagnetic Model leveraging Pretrained LLMs for Million-Sample Signal Understanding (arXiv)
items.summary: general purpose models come for exquisite war capabilities: Papers like this highlight how the steady march of generative pre-training is continuing, with the paradigm proving able to create powerful capabilities for understanding not only text, but images, audio, and as is the case here, EM signals.

items.title: CucumberVision at the Edge: Accuracy, Throughput, and Energy of RGB-D Cucumber Sizing on Jetson Orin Nano and Raspberry Pi 4 (arXiv)
items.summary: AI diffusion depends on AI miniaturization : There are lots of tasks in the world, like visually measuring properties of cucumbers, which are done today by a combination of humans and machines.
